caption: Parthenon, Athens
composition: Doric temple on the Acropolis rock, west facade from Filopappou · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Hill of the Muses (Filopappou), looking northeast, the ruined Parthenon sits centered on the Acropolis limestone. The west front and south colonnade read as a roofless Doric temple, with the Propylaea lower and to the left on the same rock. Warm-white architectural light is on the marble under a mainly clear night sky, about 12.5°C, with the city lamps below the rock. The Acropolis night lighting is the standing civic installation; no shutoff hour for 03:15 was published.
